---
title: "How Does National Well-Being Shape Global Music Consumption?"
---

## About This Project
This research explores how economic uncertainty and social support influence global music
consumption patterns using Spotify streaming data and the World Happiness Report across
20 countries.

## Key Questions
- Does uncertainty increase repetitive listening?
- Does low social support and high economic uncertainity increase positive music consumption?
- Does economic stress drive nostalgia?

## Tools & Methods
- R, tidyverse, ggplot2, Plotly
- Index construction using z-score normalization
- Cross-national correlation analysis
